sekcje: Drug Levels and Effects > Summary of Use during Lactation

Because somatrogon is poorly absorbed orally, it is not likely to reach the bloodstream of the infant or cause any adverse effects in breastfed infants. However, there is no published experience with somatrogon during breastfeeding, so an alternate drug may be preferred, especially while nursing a newborn or preterm infant. The closely related recombinant human growth hormone, somatropin, has been reported to increase milk production.
